title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:350020 rose from EUR 400.19 (po:4500012924-10) to EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10) between 2025-09-15 and 2026-09-28. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020), below your price. The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

On volumes: we plan 4580 pcs per year over a 24-month term, which gives you two years of secure planning. The attached packages offer longer payment terms to ease your cash position. Could you also tell us your earliest lead time?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your verified data regarding price history and should-cost estimates, and we appreciate the transparency.

As to the price history and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.

Our offer is a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, by extending the contract term to 24 months as you suggested, we are able to offer a more favorable price of EUR 427.96 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment term, alongside a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020: revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for verifying our data. We have taken your payment terms and contract structure as the basis and moved our price a real step towards you.

On volume and commitment: the lead package covers 4580 pcs per year over 24 months. The alternative covers the same 4580 pcs per year over 36 months, which gives your plant a full extra year of secured base load and planning certainty without a new tender.

We understand that a change of this size goes through your pricing committee. Which of the two packages fits your planning better? Could you also tell us your earliest possible lead time?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020: revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our primary offer stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Due to our strict price freeze, we can only offer a price of EUR 427.96 by trading the payment term to 30 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 36 months: €427.96 per unit. The 36-month package fits our planning better, providing secured base load.

Regarding your question, our earliest possible lead time remains as stated in our previous correspondence. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
